section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
title: DISASSEMBLY OF STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY AND TILT MECHANISM

DISASSEMBLY OF STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY AND TILT MECHANISM
(See page SR 5)

1. REMOVE IGNITION KEY CYLINDER
(a) Place the ignition key at the ACC position.
(b) Push down the stop key with a thin rod, and pull out the key cylinder.

2. REMOVE TENSION SPRINGS AND CORDS
(a) Fully tilt the main shaft upward.
(b) Pry the spring and remove the cord and spring.

3. DISCONNECT INTERMEDIATE SHAFT AND MAIN SHAFT
(a) Place matchmarks on the intermediate shaft and universal joint.
(b) Remove the joint bolt.
(c) Remove the four bracket bolts.
(d) Separate the tilt mechanism from the column tube.

4. DISCONNECT UPPER BRACKET FROM TILT STEERING SUPPORT
(a) Remove the support reinforcement.

(b) Remove the three bolts and disconnect the bracket from the support.
